problem: An uncached string anywhere in the public corpus caused offline production builds to discard every cached English translation, so /en/prijzen rendered the Dutch H1 even though its exact English translation was present in the versioned cache.
root_cause: translateAll returned null whenever STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and at least one string was missing. The route builder treated null as an all-or-nothing translation state and generated the entire English estate from Dutch source, relying on runtime translation for all content.
prevention: Offline releases must apply every available versioned English cache entry.
Only uncached strings may fall back to runtime translation.
Partial static routes must remain marked data-bg-static-translated=false so runtime completes missing strings.
One uncached string on one route must never invalidate cached English on unrelated routes.
Production pricing readback must reject a Dutch pricing H1 on /en/prijzen.

evidence.failed_job: Production Source Snapshot / Prove pricing toggles and English switch in production browser
evidence.failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1
